purpose: Prevent cross-project continuation mistakes when language-project chats are restarted or truncated.
routing_rule: When a new chat identifies a project_id, stay inside that project's roots and read its continuation/status sources before acting. Never silently switch between LANG-A1C2 and LANG-WB.
ambiguity_rule: If a language request says only 'continue/proceed' and the active project cannot be established from the current chat, consult this router and the project-specific continuation files rather than guessing from whichever language files were most recently edited.
